title: Investigating the synergistic effect of defect rich V2O5/MWCNTs heterostructure for improved electrochemical performance of supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24760-24768
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03394B, Paper

Usama Younas, Shakeel Abbas, Amina Zafar, Saqib Javed, Atia Khalid, Shafqat Hussain, Shafqat Karim, Yasir Faiz, Faisal Faiz, Amna Safdar, Amjad Nisar, Mashkoor Ahmad
V2O5/MWCNTs structure is an emerging electrode material for supercapacitor applications. The superb energy density and long cyclic stability of the assembled asymmetric coin cell device (V2O5/MWCNTs//AC) enable it for practical use.
